# Transpose an empty rectangular shape

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

An empty Array still has two distinct dimensions. Shape \[0,3\] becomes \[3,0\], without allocating elements or losing its rank.

## What this example demonstrates

An empty Array still has two distinct dimensions. Shape \[0,3\] becomes \[3,0\], without allocating elements or losing its rank.
